The Message of the Baptist to Christ (I.)

Richard Crashaw (W.) (c. 1613–1649)

M
ATT. 
XI
.
“I 
ASK,
 Who are Thou?” is the Baptist’s word.
Straight from his Master the reply is heard:
“He by whose mighty power dumb speak, blind see,
Lame walk, dead live: Who is this? I ask thee.”
